summary: Oestradiol is the main oestrogen. In women of reproductive age it changes dramatically across the menstrual cycle, so a result cannot be read without knowing which day of the cycle the sample came from.
what_it_measures: The concentration of oestradiol in blood, reported in pmol/L.

interpretations.meaning: A low oestradiol with a raised FSH is the usual pattern around menopause. In younger women it may point to reduced ovarian function.
A raised oestradiol may simply reflect the mid-cycle surge, or ovarian stimulation treatment.
typical_next_steps: repeat on days 2-5 of the cycle

when_to_seek_help: Oestradiol results are meaningless without the cycle day. Menopause is usually diagnosed clinically in women over 45 rather than by blood tests.
approved_by: Demo dataset (illustrative values, not for clinical use)
